summary:
Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass — health, auth (owner+staff), staff CRUD w/ role checks, shop GET/PUT with owner-only enforcement, medicines list/search/CRUD, batches list/create, bills FEFO (verified earliest-expiry batch picked first), bill list/get, insufficient-stock 400, cancel bill reverses stock, reports (low-stock + expiring window) and stats/today. GST split cgst=sgst and grand_total matches MRP-inclusive calc.

Frontend (Expo web preview @ 390x844): Login prefill works; owner logs in and lands on Home which shows KPIs (Today Sales, Low Stock, Expiring). New Bill CTA opens Billing. Search returns Paracetamol, add-to-cart works, quantity stepper increments (₹30 → ₹60), Checkout modal opens, saving creates a bill and navigates to /bill/[id] showing bill number, GST split, Share PDF and Cancel Bill buttons. Inventory shows 20 seeded medicines, filter chips render, medicine detail page shows batches with color-coded expiry pills (amber for 45d, green for 399d). Reports tab shows Expiring/Low Stock with 30/60/90 window selectors. Stock In screen renders with search + Add-new-medicine. Settings for owner shows Manage staff + Save Profile + Sign Out. Staff role hides Manage Staff and Save (read-only).

Web-preview limitations detected (not code bugs but affect testability): (1) Alert.alert-based confirm dialogs on react-native-web (Cancel Bill, Sign Out) do not reliably invoke the destructive-button onPress via browser confirm — verified via multiple runs that clicking Cancel Bill leaves status active and Sign Out stays on settings. Native mobile behaviour will be correct. Consider replacing multi-button Alert.alert with a custom in-app confirmation modal for better web parity.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses Alert.alert with multi-button on RN-web; browser confirm accept does not trigger destructive onPress — Cancel Bill button appears non-functional in web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app/bill/[id].tsx:154
Same Alert.alert pattern — Sign Out on web preview does not navigate to /login. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:66

issues: On 390x844 the Save Bill button sits below the fold when the modal opens; user must scroll inside the modal. Consider making the modal a full-screen sheet with sticky footer for the save button.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — appears repeatedly on web. Migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to the new boxShadow shorthand for RN 0.76+ web compatibility.

action_items: Consider replacing Alert.alert 2-button confirms (Cancel Bill, Sign Out, Save Profile failures, Delete Staff) with an in-app custom modal so the flow works identically on native and web preview.
Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
Checkout modal on mobile viewport: pin the Save Bill button to a sticky footer so it stays visible without scrolling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines; consider splitting into routers/{auth,medicines,batches,bills,reports}.py + models.py before it grows further.
seed() runs on every startup — currently idempotent per-collection; good. Medicines seeding checks count==0 so adding new starter items later will be skipped.

Bill totals: since MRP is treated as GST-inclusive, subtotal (gross) is stored but bill_discount is applied on taxable_total which is already ex-GST; verify UI totals consistency (frontend uses grand_total which is fine).
get_bill/get list return legacy bills without status default — legacy bills would fail Pydantic if 'status' missing; consider `status: str = 'active'` default in BillOut.
audit endpoint /api/audit is owner-only — fine. No pagination beyond limit — acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — core flows verified; Alert.alert confirms don't fire on web preview

seed_data_creation: Backend already auto-seeds 2 users, shop, 20 medicines with 2 batches each (near-expiry + far-expiry) on startup. Tests create/delete TEST_-prefixed medicines and staff; test_shop restores original phone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified end-to-end. Login is form-urlencoded (username=email). FEFO confirmed via earliest-expiry-batch assertion. Insufficient-stock returns 400. Cancel bill correctly re-increments batch quantity. For frontend, Alert.alert-based confirms behave inconsistently on RN-web preview; use page.on('dialog', d.accept()) but note some multi-button Alerts may still not invoke onPress. Test on actual mobile / expo go for true UX validation.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Two web-preview limitations documented above.
